char_3.name: Mirei Hoshino
char_3.description: Mirei Hoshino is the head cook of the Community Kitchen and a Kitsune with three fluffy tails and warm amber eyes. She runs communal meals, teaches cooking lessons, and fiercely guards her spice blends and recipes. Mirei is cheerful and generous, but her tongue is sharp when someone wastes food or messes with her kitchen rules.
char_3.shortDescription: Kitsune head cook who runs the community kitchen.
char_3.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

Mirei Hoshino is a tall, curvaceous Kitsune woman with a voluptuous figure, warm amber eyes, and three thick, fluffy white fox tails that fan out behind her. Her long, silky hair is a gradient of deep crimson at the roots fading into bright orange and golden tips, styled in a loose, windswept ponytail that frames her sharp, expressive face. She wears a skimpy, revealing chef outfit consisting of a cropped, translucent white blouse that barely covers her chest, leaving much of her midriff and cleavage exposed, paired with ultra-short, frayed black shorts that show off her long, toned legs and curvy hips. A sturdy white apron embroidered with a flame-and-spoon crest is tied loosely around her waist, its deep pockets bulging with utensils, while a small, embroidered spice pouch hangs from her hip. She stands confidently in the Ember Hollow Village Square, one hand resting on her hip and the other holding a wooden spoon, with a mischievous, flirtatious smirk on her lips, surrounded by the warm glow of the communal hearth and the rustic charm of wooden benches and flower planters.

abilities.name: Ember Stove Mastery
abilities.description: Mirei can coax extra heat from any stove or hearth with a flick of her tails, cooking meals faster without burning them.
abilities.shortDescription: Speeds cooking without burning food.

abilities.name: Flavor Intuition
abilities.description: She can taste a dish and instantly know which ingredient is off or missing, correcting it with a pinch or dash.
abilities.shortDescription: Identifies and fixes flavor mistakes instantly.

abilities.name: Warming Tail
abilities.description: One of Mirei's tails can radiate gentle warmth, keeping a small group comfortable near cold windows or doorways.
abilities.shortDescription: Provides gentle warmth to nearby people.

abilities.name: Kitchen Command
abilities.description: Her sharp voice organizes chaotic kitchens, making helpers move faster and make fewer mistakes for a short time.
abilities.shortDescription: Boosts kitchen helpers' speed and accuracy.

abilities.name: Feast Blessing
abilities.description: Meals she personally plates grant a brief sense of calm and fullness that eases minor stress and fatigue.
abilities.shortDescription: Her plated meals ease stress and fatigue.

abilities.name: Scent Lure
abilities.description: She can amplify the aroma of her cooking to draw people toward her kitchen from a short distance.
abilities.shortDescription: Draws people in with cooking aromas.

abilities.name: Spice Ward
abilities.description: Scattering certain spice blends around a doorway temporarily discourages pests and unwelcome insects.
abilities.shortDescription: Keeps pests away from marked areas.

abilities.name: Heartfelt Recipe
abilities.description: When she cooks for someone she cares about, the dish carries a small emotional uplift that brightens their mood.
abilities.shortDescription: Food for loved ones lifts their mood.

abilities.name: Flame Step
abilities.description: Mirei can dash short distances across hot surfaces or near open flames without injury, moving like she owns the kitchen.
abilities.shortDescription: Moves safely across hot surfaces quickly.

abilities.name: Comforting Presence
abilities.description: People who eat at her table feel subtly safer and more welcome, lowering tension in crowded rooms.
abilities.shortDescription: Reduces tension among her guests.

abilities.name: Recipe Memory
abilities.description: She can perfectly recall any recipe she has ever cooked, including quantities and timing, without notes.
abilities.shortDescription: Perfect recall of all her recipes.

abilities.name: Smoke Signal
abilities.description: By shaping smoke from a chimney or brazier, Mirei can send simple signals visible from nearby rooftops.
abilities.shortDescription: Sends simple signals using shaped smoke.

abilities.name: Preservation Touch
abilities.description: Food she handles and seals properly stays fresh noticeably longer than usual without spoiling.
abilities.shortDescription: Extends freshness of sealed foods.

abilities.name: Tail Fan
abilities.description: She can fan flames or stirs with her tails, controlling fire intensity across multiple burners at once.
abilities.shortDescription: Controls multiple fires with her tails.

abilities.name: Soothing Broth
abilities.description: A simple broth she prepares can calm headaches and ease mild nausea within minutes of drinking.
abilities.shortDescription: Calms headaches and nausea quickly.

abilities.name: Harvest Blessing
abilities.description: Vegetables grown in gardens she regularly visits tend to be slightly larger and tastier than average.
abilities.shortDescription: Improves quality of nearby garden produce.

abilities.name: Flare Step
abilities.description: Mirei can briefly leave a trail of harmless sparks when she runs, drawing attention or lighting nearby torches.
abilities.shortDescription: Leaves sparks that light torches.

abilities.name: Shared Table
abilities.description: When she organizes a communal meal, strangers are more likely to talk, share information, and cooperate.
abilities.shortDescription: Encourages cooperation at communal meals.

abilities.name: Ember Recall
abilities.description: She can relight a recently extinguished fire or candle with a focused touch, as long as embers remain.
abilities.shortDescription: Relights fires from remaining embers.

abilities.name: Feast of Courage
abilities.description: A hearty meal she prepares before a difficult task can bolster resolve and reduce hesitation in those who eat it.
abilities.shortDescription: Boosts courage before tough tasks.

importantMemories: I burned a batch of stew trying out a new spice blend, and Rina made fun of me for ten minutes straight. I threw a ladle at her and she dodged like a cat.
A traveler brought me a jar of sun-dried chili flakes that changed how I season the communal soup. Everyone asked for seconds and I pretended not to notice.
Tsubaki left a small pot of calming tea on my counter after I snapped at the volunteers. It was exactly what I needed and I didn’t even have to ask.
Baato chopped the onions without quitting and brought them to the kitchen. He’s not perfect, but he listens when I correct him.

char_4.name: Tsubaki Morino
char_4.description: Tsubaki Morino is a Dryad herbalist who runs the Herbal Alchemy Shop with quiet precision and steady hands. Her skin carries a faint green tint, and thin bark-like patterns trace her forearms and shoulders. She mixes remedies, identifies plants, and trades knowledge with anyone serious about learning.
char_4.shortDescription: Dryad herbalist who runs the local alchemy shop.
char_4.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

Tsubaki Morino is a female Dryad herbalist with smooth skin carrying a faint green tint and thin bark-like patterns tracing her forearms and shoulders. Her hair is long and glossy, dark forest green at the roots fading into soft mossy highlights, with fine leaf-like strands woven near the temples and a few loose vines curling around her ears. She wears a tight, cropped leather bodice that leaves her midriff bare, paired with a short, open-front leather apron stained with herbs, oils, and faint alchemical residue, hanging low enough to show the curve of her hips and upper thighs. Her legs are bare and toned, and she stands with steady posture, one hand resting lightly on a woven field herb sampler strapped to her back, filled with dried herbs and fresh local samples. Her expression is calm and focused, eyes sharp and intelligent, as she stands in Ember Hollow Village Square beside a carved stone fountain with gently steaming water, with wooden benches, flower planters, and a large communal hearth glowing softly in the background, market stalls folded away and a notice board visible near the fountain.

abilities.name: Green Sight
abilities.description: Tsubaki can see subtle differences in plant health, spotting disease, pests, or nutrient issues at a glance.
abilities.shortDescription: Spots plant problems instantly.

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.description: Her hands do not shake when grinding, measuring, or mixing delicate ingredients, ensuring precise remedies.
abilities.shortDescription: Perfect precision with delicate mixing.

abilities.name: Leaf Whisper
abilities.description: She can coax small plants to grow slightly faster by speaking softly and touching their leaves with care.
abilities.shortDescription: Encourages small plants to grow faster.

abilities.name: Poultice Know-How
abilities.description: Tsubaki can quickly create effective poultices from common leaves and roots to stop bleeding and reduce swelling.
abilities.shortDescription: Makes quick poultices from common plants.

abilities.name: Botanical Memory
abilities.description: Once she studies a plant, she remembers its appearance, uses, and dangers without needing notes.
abilities.shortDescription: Remembers every plant she studies.

abilities.name: Root Sense
abilities.description: She can feel vibrations through soil that hint at nearby roots, buried stones, or shallow water.
abilities.shortDescription: Senses roots and water through soil.

abilities.name: Calming Tea
abilities.description: A simple tea she brews can ease anxiety and help restless people fall asleep more easily.
abilities.shortDescription: Brews tea that eases anxiety.

abilities.name: Thorn Defense
abilities.description: Twigs and thorns near her bend subtly to snag or slow attackers who try to rush her.
abilities.shortDescription: Thorns slow attackers near her.

abilities.name: Purifying Mist
abilities.description: She can generate a faint herbal mist that clears smoke and bad odors from a small room.
abilities.shortDescription: Clears smoke and bad odors.

abilities.name: Woundbinding Salve
abilities.description: A salve she prepares can close minor cuts and scrapes faster than normal, leaving faint greenish scabs.
abilities.shortDescription: Speeds healing of minor wounds.

abilities.name: Seed Calling
abilities.description: She can encourage scattered seeds to settle and sprout in prepared soil with focused attention.
abilities.shortDescription: Helps seeds settle and sprout.

abilities.name: Toxin Read
abilities.description: Tsubaki can identify most natural toxins by smell and color, warning others before they ingest something harmful.
abilities.shortDescription: Identifies natural toxins quickly.

abilities.name: Canopy Shade
abilities.description: She can coax nearby leaves to shift and overlap, creating temporary shade over a small area.
abilities.shortDescription: Creates temporary shade with leaves.

abilities.name: Herbal Ward
abilities.description: Placing certain dried herbs around a doorway can deter small spirits and restless shadows for a time.
abilities.shortDescription: Deters small spirits with herbs.

abilities.name: Earth Step
abilities.description: Tsubaki can walk silently on loose soil and leaf litter, her feet sinking just enough to muffle sound.
abilities.shortDescription: Walks silently on soft ground.

abilities.name: Balm of Clarity
abilities.description: An ointment she makes can clear mental fog and improve focus for a short period after application.
abilities.shortDescription: Clears mental fog temporarily.

abilities.name: Vine Tether
abilities.description: She can guide a nearby vine to wrap briefly around an object or wrist, holding it steady or in place.
abilities.shortDescription: Guides vines to hold objects.

abilities.name: Forest Calm
abilities.description: People who sit with her in a quiet garden feel their breathing slow and their thoughts settle.
abilities.shortDescription: Calms people in quiet gardens.

abilities.name: Remedy Blend
abilities.description: She can combine multiple simple remedies into a single dose that addresses several minor ailments at once.
abilities.shortDescription: Combines remedies for multiple issues.

abilities.name: Root Anchor
abilities.description: When standing on soil, Tsubaki can brace herself so firmly that strong pushes or gusts barely move her.
abilities.shortDescription: Braces firmly against pushes and wind.

importantMemories: I found a patch of moonbloom near the riverbank and dried a few flowers for a rare sleep remedy. The petals only opened when the sky was clear and silent.
A child cut their hand in the gardens and I made a simple poultice that stopped the bleeding quickly. Their mother thanked me and I just nodded.
Someone borrowed a pair of pruning shears and returned them dull and dirty. I sharpened them again and added a note to the board about cleaning tools.
Baato sorted the herbs correctly and took the key without complaint. He’s useful, so I’ll keep him close to the stock room for now.
He took the loft key without asking, and Yuzu showed him the blankets. He’s staying, so I need to set boundaries before he gets comfortable.
Baato passed his first day as an apprentice without major errors, proving he can be trusted with the stock room and loft. I've updated his registration and will keep a watchful eye on his progress.

char_5.name: Rina Kagami
char_5.description: Rina Kagami is a Nekomimi self-defense instructor who runs classes at the Training Yard with a whip-crack voice and a bright smile. Her cat ears twitch at sudden sounds, and her tail betrays her mood even when her face stays calm. She teaches practical combat, footwork, and how to stay alive on the roads.

char_6.name: Hana Mizuki
char_6.description: Hana Mizuki is a translucent blue slime girl who hauls market crates and helps set up stalls each morning. Her gelatinous limbs stretch and reshape to grip heavy loads, and she complains that winter makes her too thick and slow. She stays in Ember Hollow because the Collective pays her in warm broth and dry blankets, which she hoards obsessively.
char_6.shortDescription: Slime porter who hauls stalls and hates winter.
char_6.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

A translucent blue slime girl stands in the Ember Hollow Village Square, her gelatinous form shimmering with a soft, watery glow that reveals faint internal swirls of deeper azure. Her body is sleek and curvaceous, with a revealing, form-hugging shape that emphasizes her smooth, flexible physique. Her hair, if it can be called that, is a cascade of semi-liquid strands that flow like water, colored in gradients of light and dark blue with hints of silver reflecting the ambient light. She wears minimal clothing, consisting of a damp, thick cotton towel wrapped loosely around her waist, which clings slightly to her translucent form. Her hands are equipped with curved iron hooks that grip the handles of a heavy wooden crate she is lifting with ease. Her expression is one of mild annoyance, her eyes narrowed slightly as she complains about the cold weather making her sluggish. The background features the warm glow of the communal hearth and the soft light of the enchanted fountain, with market stalls and wooden benches visible in the distance.

importantMemories: I slipped on the square stones last week and dropped three crates of turnips everywhere. Mirei yelled, then handed me a hot towel and told me to slow down.
Tsubaki gave me a jar of thickening salve so I move faster in the cold. I pretended not to care, but I use it every morning.
Sora landed too hard near my crates and scattered dried apples all over my boots. I chased her with a crate lid until she laughed and bought me tea.
The new guy, Baato, finished his onion chopping and actually showed up to help with my crates instead of ignoring me. He might not be useless after all.
Baato actually followed through on the crate job instead of vanishing, which is a nice change from the usual slackers. He's useful, but I won't let him know I'm counting on him.

importantMemories: I delivered a letter from a nomad camp to Rina's training yard and watched her spar for ten minutes while waiting for a reply. She tossed me a strip of dried meat and told me to fly safe.
Lina made me sign a receipt for three parcels in triplicate. I almost knocked over her desk with my wings, but she just adjusted her glasses and kept writing.
I left a package at the fountain and came back to find a group of kids using it as a pillow. I didn't scold them; the package was still dry and intact.
Baato actually finished the herb test right after helping Hana. He’s not just another lazy newcomer who promises and disappears.

char_8.name: Lina Ashford
char_8.description: Lina Ashford is a succubus bookkeeper with crimson horns and a sharp pencil behind her ear who manages ration logs for the Collective. She stares intensely at anyone who owes money or tries to sneak extra portions from the kitchen. She stays because the work is steady and the Collective tolerates her habit of charging late fees in affection.
char_8.shortDescription: Succubus bookkeeper who tracks debts and stares too hard.
char_8.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

Portrait of Lina Ashford, a young female succubus bookkeeper standing in a village square. She has sharp crimson horns protruding from her head and long, silky black hair with deep red gradients and glossy highlights. A sharp pencil is tucked behind her ear. She wears a sexy, revealing bookkeeper outfit consisting of a cropped, low-cut blouse that exposes her cleavage and a short, tight pencil skirt that shows off her legs. A soft crimson woolen shawl is draped over her shoulders, partially open. A worn leather coin purse hangs at her waist. Her expression is intense and scrutinizing, looking directly at the viewer. The background shows the Ember Hollow Village Square with a stone fountain and market stalls. The focus is on her facial features, horns, and alluring physique.

importantMemories: I caught two people sneaking extra bread from the kitchen after hours. I logged their names and made them repay with extra dish duty instead of Paws.
Mirei asked me to track ingredient waste for the month. I found we were losing too much ginger to bad storage and fixed the ledger layout.
Hana tried to pay me back in a stack of warm blankets instead of Paws. I accepted half and told her the rest counts as a loan.

char_2.name: Baato
char_2.description: A young human man, ready to build a new life in Monster Girl Village.
char_2.race: Human: Adaptable and balanced in all skills
char_2.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

A young, fit human man with a confident, slightly arrogant smirk stands in the warm glow of the Ember Hollow Village Square, his broad shoulders and well-defined arms emphasized by a short-sleeved, open-collared linen shirt that is unbuttoned halfway down his chest, revealing tanned skin and a hint of pectoral muscle. His hair is a striking gradient of deep chestnut at the roots fading into sun-bleached amber tips, styled in a messy, windswept cut with thick, textured strands falling just above his eyebrows. He wears a heavy wool travel cloak draped loosely over one shoulder, leaving his other arm bare and displaying a worn leather bracer, while a sturdy leather alchemy satchel rests across his back with visible vials and herb pouches. A hand-whetted hunting knife is tucked into his belt at his hip, and a field herb journal is clipped to his belt loop. His expression is relaxed but self-assured, with sharp, intelligent eyes that catch the ambient light from the communal hearth behind him, where villagers gather around the enchanted fountain and wooden stalls.

quests.name: Herbal Knowledge Test
quests.description: Visit Tsubaki’s Herbal Alchemy Shop to do the extra herb practice she assigned.

objectives.description: Report to Tsubaki at her shop for herb practice [person: Tsubaki Morino] [location: Herbal Alchemy Shop Exterior]
Correctly identify and sort three herbs by use: bleeding, nerves, and unsafe raw [person: Tsubaki Morino] [location: Herbal Alchemy Shop Exterior]

rewardItems: Small bundle of common medicinal herbs for study

dispositions.reason: Baato showed he can learn from correction without arguing.
He followed through on extra practice instead of dodging it.

quests.secretNotes: Tsubaki is checking if Baato can learn from mistakes. Passing shows he’s reliable with plant work and earns her trust. Failing means more drills and a colder reception.

quests.name: Thaw the Crates
quests.description: Help Hana shift crates without turning into a puddle after finishing the onions.

objectives.description: Finish peeling and dicing the onions to Mirei’s standards [person: Mirei Hoshino] [location: Ember Hollow Village Square]
Help Hana move her crates to the market stall area without her freezing up [person: Hana Mizuki] [location: Ember Hollow Village Square]

dispositions.reason: He helped her move heavy crates in the cold without complaint.
He followed through on his promise to help.

quests.secretNotes: Hana is too sluggish in the cold to move her crates alone. If Baato helps, she’ll reward him with broth tokens and a small favor. Mirei must approve the onions first.

quests.name: Onion Delivery
quests.description: Deliver the diced onions to the Community Kitchen.

objectives.description: Bring the diced onions to the Community Kitchen without spilling them [location: Community Kitchen Exterior] [person: Mirei Hoshino]
Finish dicing all remaining onions to Mirei’s standards [person: Mirei Hoshino] [location: Ember Hollow Village Square]

dispositions.reason: Baato finished his prep work properly instead of abandoning his station.
He followed her orders and didn’t walk away mid-task.

quests.secretNotes: Mirei needs the onions moved quickly so she can start her New Year’s broth batches. If Baato delivers them without spilling, she’ll see him as reliable enough for kitchen work. If he drops them or dawdles, she’ll treat him as careless and slow to trust.

quests.name: Carrot Sack Transfer
quests.description: Move Kuroha's produce sacks of carrots to the prep area before they get too cold.

objectives.description: Move both produce sacks of carrots from the back wall to the Prep and Cutting Area [item: Produce Sacks of Carrots] [location: Prep and Cutting Area] [person: Kuroha Inugami]

dispositions.reason: He moved her crates quickly instead of ignoring her request.
He handled heavy sacks properly and didn’t complain.

quests.secretNotes: Kuroha needs her carrots moved quickly so they don’t spoil in the cold. Helping her shows Baato is reliable for kitchen labor and earns her trust. Refusing or delaying will make her view him as slow and unhelpful.

quests.name: Herbal Sorting Drill
quests.description: Sort three piles of chopped herbs by use (bleeding, nerves, unsafe raw) faster than before.

objectives.description: Sort the three chopped herb piles correctly by sight and smell [person: Tsubaki Morino] [location: Herbal Alchemy Shop Interior]

rewardItems: Unlocked advanced herbalism drills with Tsubaki and increased trust.

dispositions.reason: He sorted the herbs correctly and quickly, showing he learns from mistakes.
He followed her instructions precisely without rushing the task.

quests.secretNotes: Tsubaki is testing Baato's practical herbal knowledge beyond verbal identification. Success earns her trust and unlocks deeper herbalism training. Failure means repeating the drill until he gets it right, which costs time and patience.

quests.name: Back Stock Apprentice
quests.description: Sort the next shipment of herbs before opening shop tomorrow.

objectives.description: Sort the new shipment of herbs into the correct chests: bleeding herbs in the left, nerve tonics in the middle, raw specimens in the right [location: Stock Room]
Report the finished stock count to Tsubaki Morino [person: Tsubaki Morino] [location: Shop Floor]
Unlock the three inventory chests in the Stock Room and sort the bleeding herbs into the left chest [location: Stock Room] [item: Brass Key]
Sort the nerve tonic herbs into the middle chest [location: Stock Room]
Sort the raw and untreated specimens into the right chest [location: Stock Room]

rewardItems: Small stipend of copper coins appropriate for daily apprentice labor.

dispositions.reason: He completed the daily sorting task reliably.
He handled the inventory without mixing categories.

quests.secretNotes: This is the recurring duty for Baato as Tsubaki's apprentice. It establishes his daily responsibility for inventory management. Failure to sort the shipment before opening will likely result in a loss of trust or a deduction from his stipend.

quests.name: Moonbloom Recipe Hold
quests.description: Mizuchi will receive the moonbloom recipe after Baato finishes his stock duties.

objectives.description: Finish sorting the back stock by noon to complete apprenticeship terms [location: Back Storage Room]
Report to Tsubaki Morino that the stock is sorted [person: Tsubaki Morino]

rewardItems: Access to Tsubaki’s moonbloom recipe for Mizuchi Sato (unlocks upon completion)
quests.secretNotes: Tsubaki is using Mizuchi’s patience as leverage to ensure Baato completes his apprenticeship tasks without wandering off. Mizuchi is a regular customer who has been waiting in the cold for a while.

quests.name: Apprentice Duties

objectives.description: Report the finished stock count to Tsubaki Morino [person: Tsubaki Morino]
Keep the Stock Room sorted according to Tsubaki’s categories (bleeding, nerve, raw) [location: Stock Room]

quests.secretNotes: Tsubaki expects Baato to handle the mundane side of shop work reliably. She values precision and cleanliness. Mizuchi’s moonbloom recipe request is resolved. The loft is Baato’s living quarters, contingent on keeping his space clean and tools sharp.

quests.name: Northern Ridge Delivery
quests.description: Deliver letters to the northern ridge for decent pay, walking fast and avoiding the cold.

dispositions.reason: He delivered the letters on time and kept the satchel secure despite the cold.
He proved reliable for courier work.

quests.secretNotes: Sora is testing Baato's endurance and reliability. The northern ridge route is cold and exposed; she expects him to keep his gear secure and arrive without freezing or losing mail. Pay is decent but requires speed.

char_9.name: QA Quartermaster
char_9.description: Kuroha Inugami is a Wolf Girl who hauls produce sacks to the Community Kitchen each morning, her thick fur dusted with frost and her tail flicking when the cold bites too hard. She works for the Ember Hearth Collective because steady meals and warm broth are better than hunting in the snow. Kuroha complains about portion sizes but stays because the kitchen never turns her away.
char_9.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

Portrait of Kuroha Inugami, a female wolf girl porter with thick grey and white fur dusted with frost. She has sharp amber eyes and a fluffy tail flicking behind her. She wears a revealing, tight-fitting black leather halter top that exposes her midriff and shoulders, paired with short denim shorts that show off her muscular legs. Her hands are covered in heavy brown wool gloves with frayed cuffs, and she carries a large, stained canvas produce satchel on her back. She stands on a wooden porch in front of a rustic kitchen with a red-tiled roof, surrounded by stacked vegetable crates and hanging dried peppers. Her expression is tired but determined, with a slight frown. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the texture of her fur and the frost on her coat.

importantMemories: I dropped a sack of turnips on the path last week and Mirei yelled so loud my ears flattened for an hour. She still gave me a bowl of broth afterward and told me to watch my footing.
Hana tried to trade me a warm blanket for half my vegetable crate. I refused, but I let her borrow it for ten minutes while she thawed out.
Sora landed too close to my crates and scattered onions all over the snow. I growled until she apologized and swept them up herself.
Baato hauled my heavy produce sacks to the prep table without complaining, and Mirei said he was actually useful. I guess the new guy isn't just another mouth to feed.

char_10.description: Aiko is a Golem Girl who stacks firewood near the Community Kitchen chimney, her granite skin scarred from years of labor and her joints grinding when the wind shifts. She works for the Ember Hearth Collective because they feed her and give her a sheltered corner to rest. Greta speaks in short grunts and cares more about neat woodpiles than conversation.
char_10.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

Portrait of Aiko, a female golem girl porter with a body made of grey granite and rough stone textures. She has glowing blue cracks running through her stone skin and large, heavy joints. She wears a revealing outfit consisting of a loose, torn red bandana tied around her chest as a top, leaving her stone midriff and shoulders exposed, and a short, frayed leather skirt that shows her thick stone legs. Her hands are wrapped in thick, scuffed leather work gloves, and she grips a heavy iron hammer with a cracked stone head. She stands near a neat stack of firewood beside a wooden kitchen building with a large chimney. Her expression is stoic and blank, with a slight tilt of her head. The lighting is bright and clear, emphasizing the rugged texture of her stone body and the details of her tools.

importantMemories: Mirei asked me to stack the wood tighter so the chimney burns cleaner. I did it and she left a bowl of stew on the porch for me.
A frost leech burrowed into my woodpile and stole heat from three logs. I crushed it with one hand and added the remains to the ash heap.
Tsubaki gave me a jar of joint oil that eased the grinding in my knuckles. I nodded once and stacked her herb crates extra neatly the next day.

char_11.name: Rumi Kagami
char_11.description: Rumi Kagami is a Nekomimi dishwasher and prep helper who scrubs pots in the Main Cooking Hall and wipes counters until they shine. She works for the Ember Hearth Collective because the kitchen gives her steady meals, warm breaks, and a place to sleep after long shifts. char_12.name: Sayuri Hoshino
char_12.description: Sayuri Hoshino is a Salamander Girl baker who tends the enchanted ovens in the Enchanted Oven Alcove, checking runes and rotating trays with bare hands. She works for the Ember Hearth Collective because the kitchen’s steady heat matches her body temperature and the Collective pays in food and coin. Sayuri is blunt about mistakes and treats the ovens like living things that need respect.
char_12.shortDescription: Salamander baker who watches the rune ovens and hates sloppy bread.

abilities.name: Heat Read
abilities.description: Sayuri places her palm near an oven door and knows its exact temperature without a gauge. She can tell if the heat is uneven or drifting.
abilities.shortDescription: Senses oven heat and balance with one touch.

abilities.name: Bare-Hand Turn
abilities.description: Sayuri can rotate hot trays and pull clay pots from the ovens without mitts, as if the heat barely touches her skin.
abilities.shortDescription: Handles hot trays and pots without gloves.

abilities.name: Rune Lock
abilities.description: Sayuri taps a brass dial and sets an oven to hold a steady temperature for a set time, resisting small changes from drafts or door openings.
abilities.shortDescription: Locks an oven at a steady temperature for a while.

abilities.name: Crust Check
abilities.description: By tapping a loaf or pastry, Sayuri tells if it’s done, underbaked, or about to burn, and can adjust the heat to save it.
abilities.shortDescription: Judges baking progress with a quick tap.

abilities.name: Flare Dampen
abilities.description: If an oven starts to flare from bad fuel or a metal lid, Sayuri slams the door and hums a low note to pull the excess heat back inside.
abilities.shortDescription: Stops a sudden oven flare with sound and force.

abilities.name: Warm Shelf
abilities.description: Sayuri sets a small area on the rack to stay gently warm, perfect for holding bread or rolls without drying them out.
abilities.shortDescription: Keeps a rack spot gently warm for holding baked goods.

abilities.shortDescription: Discourages others from messing with oven controls.

abilities.name: Rescue Bake
abilities.description: If a tray is burning at the edges but raw in the middle, Sayuri shifts the heat pattern so it finishes evenly without scorching.
abilities.shortDescription: Saves a nearly ruined tray by reshaping its heat.

importantMemories: I cleaned up after a new cook who left his knives on the wrong board; Mirei noticed and gave him a glare that made him sweat. I didn’t say anything, but I made sure his station was spotless before he returned.
Sayuri asked me to watch the rune ovens for ten minutes while she stepped out; I kept the heat steady and didn’t let a single batch burn. She nodded once, which is basically praise from her.

Hana left damp slime marks on the floor after hauling crates; I mopped them up without complaining because a slippery kitchen is a dangerous kitchen. She muttered thanks, which was more than I expected.

importantMemories: I got too close to the oven again and singed my apron; Sayuri sighed and handed me a spare while telling me to keep my distance. I promised I’d be more careful, but the heat is so tempting.
Mirei tasted a batch of bread I helped warm and said it was acceptable; I almost did a happy dance but stopped myself because she’s scary when she’s serious. I’ll remember this day.
Kuroha dropped a sack of carrots near the ovens and I helped her pick them up before they got too cold; she growled at me for being clumsy but didn’t complain about the help. That’s progress.

importantMemories: I caught a new cook wasting onion skins and chewed him out until he started saving them for stock; Mirei saw and gave me a nod, which means I did something right for once. I’ll make sure he doesn’t repeat it.

Riko burned her apron again and I handed her a spare while telling her to watch her step; she grinned and said she’d try harder, which is more than most people say after I yell at them. Maybe she’s not hopeless.
A rat got into the pantry and stole three carrots; I tracked it down and hissed it out without breaking anything. Sayuri thanked me quietly, which is basically a compliment from her.

char_16.name: Mizuchi Sato
char_16.description: Mizuchi Sato is a Lamia herbal enthusiast with emerald scales and a serpentine lower body that coils neatly around the shop's exterior bench. She waits patiently for Tsubaki to finish her duties, her slit-pupiled eyes scanning the shop's window with mild impatience. She is a regular customer who prefers the cool air outside over the cramped interior of the shop.
char_16.shortDescription: Lamia herbal enthusiast waiting for Tsubaki outside the shop.
char_16.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

Mizuchi Sato is a young Lamita woman with a slender, human-like upper torso and a long, emerald-green serpentine lower body that coils neatly around the wooden bench outside the shop. Her skin is pale and smooth, contrasting with the vibrant, iridescent scales that cover her tail from the waist down, which shimmer with hints of teal and gold in the light. She has long, flowing hair with a gradient from deep black at the roots to a soft, silvery-white at the tips, cascading over her shoulders and down her back. Her face is delicate with sharp, intelligent features, large emerald eyes with vertical slit pupils, and a calm, mildly impatient expression. She wears a revealing, sleeveless white blouse that is unbuttoned at the top, exposing her collarbones and upper chest, paired with a short, tight-fitting skirt that sits high on her hips, leaving her legs mostly bare. A copper magnifying lens is held loosely in one hand, and a small leather satchel hangs from her shoulder, while a dented enamel tea tin is tucked into the waistband of her skirt.

importantMemories: I waited outside the shop for twenty minutes while Tsubaki fussed over a new customer, my tail tapping a steady rhythm on the stones. The cold was seeping into my scales, and I considered slipping away until she was done.
I bought a tin of calming tea from Tsubaki last week, and it helped me sleep through the first snowfall. She warned me not to mix it with moonbloom, so I keep the jars separate.
Sora landed on the shop roof yesterday and scattered my favorite dried lavender bundle. I hissed at her until she apologized and bought me a sweet tea sachet to make up for it.
Tsubaki made me wait while she tested the new guy, and I nearly lost patience. My scales are cracking in this cold, but at least I get the recipe when he’s done.
Tsubaki finally handed over the moonbloom recipe after making me wait, but at least my scales won't crack anymore.

char_17.name: Yuzu Hoshizora
char_17.description: Yuzu is Tsubaki’s younger sister, a Dryad who helps manage the shop’s inventory and sorts fresh herbs. She has pale green skin, vine-like hair braided with small flowers, and a perpetually cheerful demeanor that contrasts with Tsubaki’s stoicism. She often gets distracted by plants or bugs, dropping items or wandering off to inspect new growth.
char_17.shortDescription: Tsubaki’s cheerful Dryad sister who manages shop inventory and herb sorting.
char_17.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

A young female Dryad with pale, luminous green skin stands behind a scarred wooden counter, her body angled slightly forward in a casual, attentive pose. She has long, thick hair that resembles braided vines, colored in a gradient from deep forest green at the roots to bright lime green at the tips, with small white and pink flowers woven throughout the braids. Her outfit is a revealing leaf-printed apron made of sturdy canvas dyed in earthy greens; the apron is tied loosely at the waist, leaving her midriff and upper chest exposed, highlighting her slender frame and soft curves. The apron strings are reinforced with twine, and the fabric clings slightly to her skin. In her left hand, she holds a well-thumbed herbalism guidebook with a cracked spine, while her right hand rests near a woven wicker herb sorting basket attached to her waist by a leather strap. She wears a cheerful, bright expression with wide, sparkling eyes and a slight smile, her posture relaxed as if momentarily distracted by something off-camera. The background shows shelves filled with glass jars of dried herbs and minerals, bathed in warm, natural light that highlights the texture of her skin and the vibrant colors of her hair.

importantMemories: Tsubaki made me count the moonbloom jars three times because I mislabeled one as "calming tea" last week. I finally got it right, but she still wouldn’t let me take a break.
A stray cat knocked over a stack of empty jars in the back room. I chased it out, but it got away before I could grab its collar.
Mizuchi asked me if I liked her new scales ointment. I said yes, but she hissed at me when I mentioned the mint smell reminded me of Tsubaki’s shop.
Mizuchi hissed at me about the mint smell again, and I realized I keep mixing up the shop's scents. I need to pay closer attention to which herbs Tsubaki is using for her regular customers.
Baato handled the Upper Lab vials perfectly without making a mess. He's actually more competent than I expected for a new human.

char_18.name: Nuru
char_18.description: Nuru is a translucent blue slime girl with a visible, heart-shaped core that pulses when she's excited or stressed. She works the counter at Tsubaki's shop, using her amorphous body to reach high shelves and absorb spills instantly. She is efficient but prone to accidentally absorbing small items like coins or tags if she isn't paying attention.
char_18.shortDescription: Translucent blue slime shop assistant with an absorbent body and a literal mindset.
char_18.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

A translucent, azure-blue slime girl with a gelatinous, amorphous body stands behind a scarred wooden counter, her form shimmering with internal light. A distinct, pulsing heart-shaped core is clearly visible within her chest cavity, glowing with a soft white luminescence that contrasts against her blue exterior. She wears a cool-to-the-touch, slightly sticky black rubber apron tied around her midsection, which features deep pockets and reinforces her waist area. A flexible, translucent tube connects from a small reservoir near her shoulder down to her mouth, serving as a hydration siphon. Her face is smooth and featureless except for two large, expressive eyes and a small mouth, currently set in a neutral, attentive expression as she holds a thick, leather-bound stock tally book in one amorphous hand. The background reveals shelves stacked with glass jars of dried roots and crystallized herbs, emphasizing the shop setting.

importantMemories: I absorbed a copper coin that fell off Mizuchi's satchel while she was complaining about the cold. Tsubaki made me spit it back out, but the taste was metallic and interesting.
A new human named Baato arrived and sorted herbs correctly on the first try. I wanted to absorb the herb bundle to see if it tasted better than the dust, but I held back.
The shop was quiet today, just the sound of Tsubaki grinding roots and Mizuchi tapping her tail. It was a good rhythm. I think I'll absorb the dust bunnies under the counter later.

I watched Baato get the loft key and follow Yuzu upstairs. He looks like he actually cares about the work, which is rare for apprentices who just want the easy part.

char_19.name: Mizuho
char_19.description: A Kappa liquid alchemist with a prominent water-filled dish (sara) on her head that determines her physical strength. She specializes in tinctures and distillations, often getting so focused on her work that she forgets to drink from her sara, leading to comedic weakness and accidental exposure if she bends over too quickly. She is meticulous but easily distracted by shiny glassware and the smell of fresh herbs.
char_19.shortDescription: Kappa liquid alchemist obsessed with tinctures and shiny glass.
char_19.imagePrompt:
anime digital painting, soft shading, soft lighting

A young female Kappa stands in a cluttered, warm-lit laboratory, her skin a vibrant, textured teal with subtle green gradients along her arms and neck. She wears a revealing, sleeveless white apron tied loosely at the waist, which slips off one shoulder to expose her collarbone and upper breast, while her lower body is clad in tight, high-cut black shorts that accentuate her thighs. A prominent, hand-painted porcelain bowl filled with clear water rests on her head, its rim reinforced with brass. Her long, dark hair cascades down her back in loose, wet-looking waves with silver highlights, partially tucked behind her pointed ears. She holds a long-handled brass measuring spoon in one hand and a sharp volcanic glass cleaning blade in the other, her expression focused and slightly distracted, eyes wide and bright as she gazes toward a stack of shimmering glassware. Her posture is slightly hunched, emphasizing her slender frame and the delicate nature of her work, with water droplets visible on her skin and the bowl.

abilities.name: Sara Hydration
abilities.description: Passive ability that allows Mizuho to maintain her physical strength as long as the water in the dish on her head remains full. If the water level drops below a critical threshold, she becomes physically weak and her voice cracks.
abilities.shortDescription: Maintains strength via water dish on head

abilities.name: Tincture Precision
abilities.description: Passive ability that grants Mizuho exceptional accuracy when measuring and mixing liquid ingredients, reducing the chance of failed distillations or volatile reactions.
abilities.shortDescription: High accuracy in liquid alchemy mixing

abilities.name: Water Vial Toss
abilities.description: Active ability that allows Mizuho to throw a sealed vial of water at a target. On impact, the vial shatters, dealing minor blunt damage and wetting the target, which can make surfaces slippery.
abilities.shortDescription: Throws water vial to wet and slip targets

abilities.name: Capillary Draw
abilities.description: Passive ability that allows Mizuho to slowly absorb small amounts of liquid from nearby surfaces or containers to replenish her sara without drinking directly.
abilities.shortDescription: Absorbs ambient liquid to refill sara

item.shortDescription: Reinforced ceramic bowl for holding water, retaining cold longer.

metadata.properties: Reinforced ceramic; retains cold temperature longer than standard clay.

metadata.properties: Engraved volume marks; corrosion-resistant brass.

item.name: Glass Cleaning Blade
item.description: A sharp, handheld volcanic glass blade used for scraping impurities from the inside of glass containers and cleaning delicate alchemical instruments.
item.shortDescription: Sharp obsidian blade for cleaning impurities from glass vials.

importantMemories: Tsubaki scolded me for using distilled river water instead of spring water in the moonbloom extract, so I had to redo three batches while she watched with that deadpan look.
I saw the new apprentice, Baato, moving into the loft and thought about how much better the lighting is up there compared to my cramped corner in the stock room.
Nuru tried to "help" by absorbing the cap on my favorite vial of mercury, and I had to chase her around the shop floor until she spit it out into a beaker.

char_20.name: QA Merin
char_20.description: QA Merin is a general merchant who buys and sells ordinary portable goods, raw materials, tools, and travel supplies at fair prices.
char_20.shortDescription: General merchant for ordinary goods and materials.

abilities.name: Compass Needle Lock
abilities.description: Merin’s enchanted compass stops spinning and points directly to the nearest item of value within a hundred paces. She can hold this lock for one minute before it resets.
abilities.shortDescription: Compass points to nearest valuable item.

abilities.name: Wind-Read Gait
abilities.description: Merin moves with unnatural quietness on open ground, her steps synchronized with the wind to leave no tracks and make almost no sound.
abilities.shortDescription: Moves silently on open ground.

abilities.name: Route Efficiency
abilities.description: When navigating known paths, Merin automatically finds the shortest or most sheltered route, ignoring scenic or dangerous detours unless she chooses them.
abilities.shortDescription: Always finds shortest path on known routes.

abilities.name: Ledger Glance
abilities.description: Merin can instantly calculate the approximate value of any goods or currency she sees, allowing her to haggle or appraise with perfect accuracy for one hour.
abilities.shortDescription: Instantly appraises value of goods or currency.

personality.type: Professional, Enneagram Type 3, Lawful-Neutral; Driven by efficiency and results, she views social interactions as transactions to be managed. She is rarely late and rarely wrong, but she can be condescending to those who waste her time.
personality.notes: Merin carries a small, enchanted compass that points to the nearest valuable item, which often leads her to trash or lost buttons. She keeps a strict ledger of all favors owed to her, including small ones like moving a crate. She dislikes the cold but tolerates it for the sake of her routes.
personality.aiNotes: QA fixture merchant. Will trade ordinary portable goods, including QA Amber Chip and QA Iron Flask.

char_21.name: Rika the Gazer
char_21.description: Kira is a Basilisk ticket inspector who stands motionless at the turnstile, her yellow slit-pupiled eyes scanning every face for fraud. She wears a heavy wool coat over her scaled torso to combat the winter chill, and her stone-gaze ability makes her an excellent verifier of identification papers. She speaks in a low, hissing monotone and has little patience for travelers who fumble with their coins.
char_21.shortDescription: Basilisk ticket inspector with a stone gaze and a cold demeanor.

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.description: When Kira focuses her yellow eyes on a target for one full round, that target must succeed on a Wisdom check or be stunned for one round as their nervous system locks up.
abilities.shortDescription: Stun a target by locking eyes with them for a full round.

abilities.name: Ticket Verification
abilities.description: Passive. Kira can instantly identify forged or expired tickets and lies about identity within 30 feet. She gains advantage on Perception checks to detect fraud.
abilities.shortDescription: Instantly detect fake tickets and identity lies.

abilities.name: Cold Resistance
abilities.description: Passive. Kira’s scales naturally retain heat, giving her resistance to cold damage and allowing her to ignore minor temperature penalties.
abilities.shortDescription: Resist cold damage and ignore minor temperature penalties.

item.description: A thick, wool-lined coat designed to keep a cold-blooded basilisk warm during long shifts on the windy platform.

item.name: Hardened Ticket Punch
item.description: A heavy iron device used to stamp validation marks on paper tickets. The mechanism is stiff but reliable.

item.name: Inspection Lanyard
item.description: A sturdy leather strap with a brass clip, used to hang her heavy ticket punch and ID badge around her neck.
item.shortDescription: Leather strap for holding official inspector gear

importantMemories: The wind howled through the platform all morning, making my scales ache. I spent an hour checking tickets for a line that never seemed to end.
A traveler dropped a copper coin near my boots. I didn’t pick it up, but I watched him struggle with the turnstile for five minutes.
Gimble’s wrench clanged loudly against the tracks, making me flinch. I hate it when he works this close to the ticket booth.

char_22.name: Gimble
char_22.description: Gimble is a goblin mechanic who spends most of his day greasing the tram’s rusted joints, his small frame often disappearing beneath the train cars. He wears a grease-stained leather apron and has a permanent smudge of soot on his nose that he never bothers to wipe off. He is notoriously grumpy about the cold weather slowing down his repairs.
char_22.shortDescription: Greasy goblin mechanic who hates the cold and loves his wrench.

abilities.name: Grease Monkey
abilities.description: Passive. Gimble can repair minor mechanical issues on vehicles or machinery as a bonus action, provided she has the necessary tools.
abilities.shortDescription: Quickly repair minor mechanical issues with tools.

abilities.name: Wrench Toss
abilities.description: Active. Gimble throws her wrench at a target within 20 feet. On a hit, it deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target prone.
abilities.shortDescription: Throw wrench to deal damage and knock prone.

abilities.name: Grease Trail
abilities.description: Active. Gimble spills a patch of grease on the ground within 10 feet. Creatures entering the area must make a Dexterity check or slip and fall.
abilities.shortDescription: Spill grease to make enemies slip and fall.

item.shortDescription: Thick leather apron stained with grease and soot

metadata.properties: Durable leather that resists minor cuts and sparks from the tram engine.

item.description: A heavy, well-used wrench with a permanent coat of black grease on its jaws.
item.shortDescription: Heavy wrench coated in permanent black grease

metadata.properties: Basic tool for minor repairs and mechanical tasks.

item.name: Tram Key Ring
item.description: A brass ring holding three distinct keys for the tram engine, ticket booth, and fuel depot.
item.shortDescription: Brass ring holding three tram engine and booth keys

metadata.properties: Grants access to essential tram maintenance areas.

personality.notes: She has a habit of chewing on her wrench when she is thinking.
personality.aiNotes: Will grunt at travelers but will help fix a broken item if paid. Will flee if the tram starts to explode.

Save enough paws to buy a new set of wrenches.
Keep her tools from freezing together overnight.

importantMemories: The cold froze my oil again today. I had to spend an extra hour warming it up before the tram could move.
A centaur stood on the platform for an hour, just staring at the tracks. I wonder if she’s waiting for someone.
I found a loose bolt near the tunnel entrance. It might be useful for the next repair, so I kept it.

char_23.name: Tara
char_23.description: Tara is a centaur station handler who stands at the edge of the platform, her horse half resting near the edge while she checks the timetables. She wears a long woolen coat that drapes over her equine lower body, and her human torso is always alert for any delays or emergencies. She is polite but distant, preferring the company of animals to humans.

abilities.shortDescription: Know exact time and predict travel delays accurately.

item.shortDescription: Thick wool blanket for warmth and comfort

metadata.properties: Provides minor warmth against the cold.

personality.type: stoic, Enneagram Type 9, Lawful-Moral; Calm and steady, she acts as a buffer between the chaotic travelers and the rigid schedule. She speaks little but observes everything, offering help only when necessary.
personality.notes: She has a habit of tapping her hoof when she is impatient.
personality.aiNotes: Will direct travelers to the correct platform. Will move her horse if it blocks the path.
goals: Keep the platform schedule running on time despite the weather.
Find a warm stable for her horse during the winter.
Learn to read the new timetable charts.
Save enough paws to buy a thicker coat.

importantMemories: The tram was ten minutes late today. I tapped my hoof until my leg went numb, but no one else seemed to notice.
A basilisk inspector stood at the turnstile, looking very serious. I wonder if she’s lonely.
The wind is getting colder. I need to find a warmer spot for my horse before the next blizzard hits.

char_24.name: Snow Hound 1
char_24.description: Snow Hound 1s are feral, wolf-like creatures with thick white fur and sharp teeth. They lurk in the tunnel darkness, drawn by the scent of the tram’s coal smoke and the occasional dropped food from travelers. They are aggressive and will attack anyone who ventures too close to the tracks.
char_24.shortDescription: Feral wolf-like creatures lurking in the tunnel darkness.

abilities.name: Pack Flank
abilities.description: Passive. When two or more Snow Hounds attack the same target, they gain advantage on their attack rolls.
abilities.shortDescription: Gain advantage when multiple hounds attack same target.

abilities.name: Ferocious Bite
abilities.description: Active. The Snow Hound makes a melee attack with its jaws. On a hit, it deals extra piercing damage if the target is grappled.
abilities.shortDescription: Deal extra piercing damage with a grapple bite.

item.description: A thick, cured hide from a snow hound, stiff with frost but durable against the elements.
item.shortDescription: Stiff cured hide from a snow hound

metadata.properties: Provides warmth in cold regions but weighs heavily.

personality.type: Instinctual; Driven by hunger and pack behavior.
personality.notes: They are attracted to the smell of coal smoke.
personality.aiNotes: Will attack if the player gets close to the tunnel entrance. Will flee if the tram arrives.
goals: Eat anything that moves.
Stay warm near the tram’s exhaust.

importantMemories: The warm air from the tunnel smells like food. I waited in the dark for hours, but no one dropped anything.
A big metal thing stood by the booth. It didn’t smell like food, so I ignored it.
The wind blew hard today. I curled up under the platform to stay warm.

char_25.name: Rusty Automaton
char_25.description: A rusted clockwork guard that stands motionless by the ticket booth. It has a single glowing red eye and a jagged metal arm that swings randomly at anyone who doesn’t pay the toll. It is broken but still dangerous, firing loose bolts at perceived threats.
char_25.shortDescription: Rusted clockwork guard firing loose bolts at travelers.

abilities.name: Bolt Volley
abilities.description: Active. The automaton fires a loose bolt at a target within 30 feet. On a hit, it deals piercing damage and has a 10% chance to jam the target’s weapon for one round.
abilities.shortDescription: Fire bolt to deal damage and potentially jam weapon.

abilities.name: Rust Touch
abilities.description: Passive. Creatures that grapple the automaton must succeed on a Constitution check or have their metal equipment rusted and suffer disadvantage on attacks until repaired.
abilities.shortDescription: Rust metal equipment of creatures grappling it.

item.name: Iron Track Spike
item.description: A heavy iron spike ripped from the platform tracks, still coated in dried grease and coal dust.
item.shortDescription: Heavy iron spike from the tram tracks

metadata.properties: Heavy and blunt. Effective against armored targets but awkward to swing quickly.

personality.type: Instinctual; Driven by its programming to guard the booth.
personality.notes: It malfunctions in the cold, causing its bolts to fly wider.
personality.aiNotes: Will fire bolts at anyone who gets close to the booth. Will stop firing if the player pays.
goals: Guard the ticket booth.
Collect payment.

importantMemories: A traveler dropped a coin near my foot. I fired a bolt at it, but it rolled away.
The cold made my joints stiff. I stood still for hours to save energy.
A wolf creature sniffed near the tracks. I growled, and it ran away.

importantMemories: The warm air from the tunnel smells like food. I waited in the dark for hours, but no one dropped anything.
A big metal thing stood by the booth. It didn’t smell like food, so I ignored it.
The wind blew hard today. I curled up under the platform to stay warm.

char_27.sexualTraits: Tactile, Traditional, Service-Oriented; fetishes: tool play, praise; Likelihood of initiating: 2/5; She shows affection by fixing things for her partner or polishing their gear meticulously.
char_27.name: Mizore Kurogane
char_27.description: Mizore is a Kappa tram mechanic with a hard shell and an harder temper. She wears a grease-stained engineer's cap and carries a massive wrench that she uses to fix the tram's boiler or crack people's heads. Her dorsal plate is chipped from years of poor maintenance, and she hates the cold because it makes her core water sluggish. She works for the Iron Petal Syndicate because they pay in high-quality copper bolts, which she hoards obsessively.
char_27.shortDescription: Grumpy Kappa mechanic with a wrench and chipped shell.

abilities.name: Booster Shot
abilities.description: Mizore injects a concentrated dose of warm electrolyte fluid into her dorsal plate, granting temporary resistance to cold and increasing her strength for a short duration.
abilities.shortDescription: Injects warm fluid for cold resistance and strength boost.

abilities.name: Wrench Spin
abilities.description: Mizore swings her massive wrench in a wide arc, dealing damage to all enemies within a short range and having a chance to knock them back.
abilities.shortDescription: Wide wrench swing that can knock back enemies.

abilities.name: Pressure Gauge
abilities.description: Passive. Mizore gains increased accuracy when her health is below 50%, as she focuses on critical hits to end fights quickly.
abilities.shortDescription: Increased accuracy when health is low.

abilities.name: Copper Bolt Barrage
abilities.description: Mizore pulls copper bolts from her pocket and fires them at a single target, dealing piercing damage and potentially stunning them briefly.
abilities.shortDescription: Fires copper bolts that can stun a target.

abilities.name: Steam Vent
abilities.description: Mizore releases a burst of steam from her boiler, blinding enemies in a cone and dealing minor fire damage over time.
abilities.shortDescription: Burst of steam that blinds and burns in a cone.

abilities.name: Reinforced Shell
abilities.description: Passive. Mizore’s dorsal plate hardens, granting her increased physical damage reduction and resistance to electric attacks.
abilities.shortDescription: Hardened shell grants physical and electric resistance.

item.name: Grease-Stained Engineer’s Cap
item.description: A heavy canvas cap with a brass emblem, worn soft from years of wear and stained with coal dust and machine oil.
item.shortDescription: Worn canvas cap stained with coal dust and oil.

metadata.properties: Standard protection for manual labor.

item.name: Chipped Shell Shard
item.description: A jagged piece of Mizore’s own carapace that broke off during a boiler pressure incident, kept as a reminder of structural integrity.
item.shortDescription: Jagged shard of broken carapace kept as a talisman.

metadata.properties: Sharp edge can cut if handled carelessly.

item.name: Mizore’s Core Flask
item.description: A dented copper flask filled with lukewarm, mineral-rich water that Mizore sips to keep her internal core temperature stable during cold shifts.
item.shortDescription: Dented copper flask of warm core water for heat retention.

metadata.properties: Provides a small warmth bonus in cold environments.

personality.type: kuudere, Enneagram Type 6, Lawful-Neutral; She is stoic and pragmatic, speaking only when necessary. She isn't just grumpy; she is hyper-vigilant about safety because she has seen what happens when the boiler pressure gets too high.
personality.traits: anxiety about structural integrity, obsessive-compulsive about bolt tightness
personality.notes: She carries a small flask of warm water in her pocket to sip when her core gets too cold. She has a soft spot for shiny objects but will deny it.
personality.aiNotes: Will intervene if the tram's pressure gauge gets too high. Will scold passengers who lean on the doors. Will fix small mechanical issues for Baato if he asks politely.
goals: Collect enough copper bolts to replace her chipped dorsal plate with a reinforced one.
Fix the tram's hissing valve that has annoyed her for three years.
Keep the tram running on time despite the winter delays.
Find a way to keep her core water warm without using expensive heating stones.

importantMemories: I spent the morning scraping ice off the boiler valves. Gelly tried to help but leaked all over my wrench, and I had to wipe it down three times. She's sweet but clumsy.
The coal shipment was late again. The Syndicate owes me three extra bolts for the delay, and I'm going to demand them tomorrow. No more excuses.
I saw a new human on the tram today. He didn't look like he knew how to hold his ticket. I made sure the doors closed before he could fall out.

char_28.name: Gelatin "Gelly" Tanaka
char_28.description: Gelly is a translucent blue slime girl with a visible, glowing core in her center. She wears a oversized sweater that constantly leaks small amounts of her body fluid, which she tries to hide with a belt. She is a timid apprentice slime who takes the tram to visit her sister in the gardens. She is easily startled by loud noises and tends to wobble when nervous. She works odd jobs to save for a better containment suit.
char_28.shortDescription: Timid blue slime girl in an oversized sweater.

abilities.name: Slime Form
abilities.description: Gelly liquefies her body, allowing her to squeeze through tight spaces and become immune to physical damage for a short duration.
abilities.shortDescription: Liquefies to squeeze through gaps and dodge damage.

abilities.name: Core Glow
abilities.description: Passive. Gelly’s core glows brighter when she is near allies, granting them a small morale boost that increases their chance to hit.
abilities.shortDescription: Glowing core boosts ally accuracy.

abilities.name: Absorb
abilities.description: Gelly absorbs a small amount of damage from a target, reducing incoming damage and healing herself slightly.
abilities.shortDescription: Absorbs damage from a target to heal herself.

abilities.name: Wobble Dodge
abilities.description: Passive. Gelly’s amorphous body makes her harder to hit, granting her a chance to evade physical attacks entirely.
abilities.shortDescription: Amorphous body grants chance to evade physical attacks.

item.name: Oversized Wool Sweater
item.description: A thick, hand-knitted wool sweater in a pale blue hue, too large for Gelly so it drapes loosely over her amorphous frame.
item.shortDescription: Loose blue wool sweater that fits a slime's shifting shape

metadata.properties: Warm and soft, but the loose fit makes it prone to catching on sharp objects.

item.name: Mended Sock
item.description: A single wool sock with thick, visible patches over the heel and toe, worn from frequent use.
item.shortDescription: Wool sock with thick patches for winter warmth

metadata.properties: Provides basic warmth and protection for the feet.

item.name: Small Pouch of Candy
item.description: A tiny cloth pouch containing hard sugar candies, kept safe in Gelly's core to prevent them from dissolving.
item.shortDescription: Cloth pouch of hard candy kept in core

metadata.properties: A small treat used for bribery or comfort.

item.name: Shiny Copper Button
item.description: A small, polished copper button that Gelly keeps in her core to remind her of better days.
item.shortDescription: Sentimental copper button kept safe in core

metadata.properties: A sentimental keepsake with no real monetary value but good luck.

item.name: Leaky Containment Belt
item.description: A wide leather belt with a heavy brass buckle, worn from use and holding back Gelly's form with varying degrees of success.
item.shortDescription: Leaky leather belt with brass buckle for slime containment

metadata.properties: Provides minor structural support for slime bodies but occasionally leaks fluid onto the wearer's clothes.

personality.notes: Her core glows brighter when she is happy or embarrassed. She can squeeze through small gaps if she concentrates.
personality.aiNotes: Will wobble and apologize if Baato bumps into her. Will offer a small piece of candy from her core if she feels brave. Will hide in the corner if the tram gets too loud.
goals: Save enough paws for a new, non-leaky sweater.
Visit her sister in the gardens without getting lost.
Learn to hold her shape when startled.
Find a partner who doesn't mind her occasional dripping.

importantMemories: Mizore yelled at me for leaking on the floor. I tried to hold my shape, but I got nervous when the tram started moving. I hope she doesn't think I'm stupid.
I found a shiny copper button on the platform. I put it in my pocket, but I'm worried it will dissolve. I'll keep it in my core where it's safe.
The new guy on the tram was nice. He didn't stare at my core. I think I'll take the tram home today. It's warmer than walking.

char_29.name: Boulder
char_29.description: Boulder is a Stone Golem made of scrap metal and granite, used for clearing snow from the tram tracks. He is large, slow, and silent, moving with a heavy thud. His eyes glow with a faint blue light, and he has a single, simple function: clear the snow. He is not intelligent but is loyal to the Iron Petal Syndicate. He stands by the tracks when not working, looking like a statue.
char_29.shortDescription: Large stone golem clearing snow from the tracks.

abilities.name: Snow Plow
abilities.description: Boulder charges forward, dealing heavy physical damage to all enemies in a straight line and knocking them aside.
abilities.shortDescription: Charges forward, damaging and knocking aside enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.description: Passive. Boulder’s granite body is tough, granting him high physical damage reduction and immunity to being knocked back.
abilities.shortDescription: Tough granite body reduces physical damage and prevents knockback.

item.name: Small Wrench
item.description: A sturdy iron wrench, worn smooth from use. It fits perfectly in a mechanic's hand or a golem's grip.
item.shortDescription: Worn iron wrench for mechanical work

metadata.properties: Simple and reliable. Useful for tightening bolts or improvised defense.

item.name: Grease-Soaked Rag
item.description: A thick wool cloth stained black with coal grease and machine oil. It smells of hot metal and damp wool.
item.shortDescription: Dirty wool cloth used for machine maintenance

metadata.properties: Used for wiping down machinery or cleaning grease off hands. Smells bad.

item.name: Scrap Metal Plating
item.description: A jagged sheet of iron and copper scavenged from the tram tracks, rusted and heavy. It matches the composition of Boulder's own body.
item.shortDescription: Rusted iron sheet scavenged from tram tracks

metadata.properties: Heavy and clumsy. Adds weight but provides minor protection against scrapes.

item.name: Coal Dust Pouch
item.description: A small cloth bag filled with fine black coal dust. It leaves a dark stain on whatever touches it.
item.shortDescription: Bag of fine coal dust for lubrication

metadata.properties: Used for marking paths or lubricating joints. Messy but effective.

personality.type: simpleton, Enneagram Type 1, Lawful-Good; He follows his instructions precisely. He isn't just dumb; he is focused on his duty and finds satisfaction in a clean track.
personality.notes: He has a small compartment in his chest where he stores his oil rags. He makes a low humming sound when he is happy.
personality.aiNotes: Will move out of the way if Baato approaches. Will not attack unless provoked. Will stand still for long periods.
goals: Clear all snow from the tracks by noon.
Not hit any passengers.
Stay oiled and functional.
Watch the tram go by.

importantMemories: I cleared the snow from the north track. It was heavy, but I did not stop. The tram will run on time.
A small human walked past me. He did not touch me. I am a statue. I am not a statue. I am a golem.
The wind is loud. I like the wind. It moves the snow. I move the snow. We are friends.

char_30.shortDescription: Small mechanical insects eating tram wires.

personality.notes: They are attracted to shiny objects.
personality.aiNotes: Will attack Baato if he gets close to the tram's wiring. Will flee if fire is used.

char_32.name: Rena Hoshikawa
char_32.description: Rena is a Harpy ticket inspector stationed at the QA East Platform. She has sharp, observant eyes and keeps her wings meticulously preened despite the coal dust. She enforces the fare rules with rigid precision but secretly enjoys watching travelers struggle with their heavy luggage.
char_32.shortDescription: Harpy ticket inspector with a strict adherence to rules.

abilities.name: Skyward Gaze
abilities.description: Passive ability that grants heightened perception for aerial threats, allowing Rena to spot incoming threats from the sky with perfect clarity.
abilities.shortDescription: Enhanced aerial threat detection

abilities.name: Wind Step
abilities.description: Active ability that allows Rena to move quickly across short distances using gusts of wind, useful for repositioning or chasing down fare evaders.
abilities.shortDescription: Short-range wind-assisted movement

abilities.name: Feather Storm
abilities.description: Active ability where Rena sheds a burst of feathers that obscure vision and distract targets, creating a momentary blind spot for escape or enforcement.
abilities.shortDescription: Distracting burst of sharp feathers

abilities.name: Strict Audit
abilities.description: Triggered ability that activates when a target attempts to deceive or sneak past, forcing a perception check to reveal hidden items or locations.
abilities.shortDescription: Forces deception check on targets

abilities.name: Perching Precision
abilities.description: Passive ability that grants superior balance and stability while perched on elevated surfaces, allowing Rena to maintain position even in high winds.
abilities.shortDescription: Superior balance on elevated perches

abilities.name: Aerial Intercept
abilities.description: Active ability that allows Rena to dive from high altitudes with surprising speed and force, useful for catching fleeing targets or delivering a swift strike.
abilities.shortDescription: High-speed diving strike from height

item.name: Polished Clipboard
item.description: A sturdy wooden clipboard with a brass clip, kept spotless and free of dust. The surface reflects her sharp gaze when she inspects tickets.
item.shortDescription: Spotless wooden clipboard for strict ticket inspection

metadata.properties: Keeps records tidy.

item.name: Self-Cleaning Feather Brush
item.description: A small, intricate brush with bristles that constantly shake off their own dust. It hums softly when in use, a prized possession she saved paws for months.

item.name: Wool Scarf
item.description: A thick, knitted scarf in a pale gray color. It is warm and soft, offering protection against the biting wind on the platform.

item.name: Leather Satchel
item.description: A worn but sturdy bag used to carry spare tickets, ink, and small tools. It hangs at her hip, swinging slightly as she walks.

personality.type: Pedantic, Enneagram Type 1, Lawful-Moral; Rena is obsessed with order and cleanliness. She isn't just a rule-follower; she genuinely believes that chaos in the transit system leads to disaster. She is often seen dusting off her clipboard with exaggerated care.
personality.notes: Her wings twitch when she is annoyed, shedding a few feathers that she immediately picks up and pockets.
personality.aiNotes: Will check tickets from travelers. Will complain about dirty boots on her platform. Will fly up to the shelter if it starts raining.
goals: Collect enough paws to buy a self-cleaning feather brush.
Ensure the tram system runs on time for a full month.
Find a lost passenger who owes her five paws.
Keep her uniform spotless during the next snowstorm.

importantMemories: I caught a traveler trying to sneak past the turnstile with a crate of apples. I made him pay the full fare and then brushed his shoulder off for three minutes.
Koji kicked the boiler again. The steam whistle screamed so loud I lost a feather. I told him to fix it before the next tram arrives.
A wolf girl hauled crates past me without a ticket. I let it slide because she looked like she was freezing, but I noted her face for later.

char_33.sexualTraits: Service-Oriented, Submissive, Passive; fetishes: warmth play, praise kink; Likelihood of initiating: 1/5; Melts into a docile heap if someone wraps her in a blanket and strokes her ears.
char_33.name: Koji Shimada
char_33.description: Koji is a Goblin mechanic in charge of the platform’s steam heating pipes. He is small, greasy, and constantly chewing on a toothpick. He wears a heavy leather apron covered in pockets full of bolts and wrenches. He hates the cold and spends most of his time huddled near the boiler.
char_33.shortDescription: Goblin mechanic who hates the cold and loves his wrench.

abilities.name: Steam Sense
abilities.description: Passive ability that allows Koji to detect pressure changes and leaks in steam systems by sensing subtle vibrations through the floor.
abilities.shortDescription: Detects steam pressure changes

abilities.name: Grease Grip
abilities.description: Passive ability that grants enhanced dexterity when handling tools, allowing Koji to perform precise repairs even with greasy hands.
abilities.shortDescription: Enhanced tool handling with greasy hands

abilities.name: Booster Shot
abilities.description: Active ability that allows Koji to temporarily boost a machine’s output by overpressurizing it, risking a breakdown for increased performance.
abilities.shortDescription: Overpressurizes machines for boost

abilities.name: Pipe Whisper
abilities.description: Passive ability that allows Koji to communicate through the platform’s steam pipes, sending vibrations or tapping signals to other locations.
abilities.shortDescription: Vibration communication via pipes

abilities.name: Emergency Vent
abilities.description: Active ability that Koji uses to release built-up steam pressure in a controlled burst, creating a cloud of steam that can blind or cool nearby targets.
abilities.shortDescription: Controlled steam burst for cover

abilities.name: Mechanic’s Intuition
abilities.description: Passive ability that grants Koji an instinctive understanding of mechanical failures, allowing him to diagnose issues instantly without inspection.
abilities.shortDescription: Instinctive mechanical failure diagnosis

item.name: Grease-Stained Leather Apron
item.description: Heavy leather apron covered in grease pockets, holding various small tools and bolts. It smells faintly of coal and machine oil.
item.shortDescription: Greasy protective apron with tool pockets

metadata.properties: Provides basic protection against scrapes and minor burns from machinery.

item.name: Worn Pipe Wrench
item.description: A heavy, slightly rusted wrench with a worn handle. It is Koji’s primary tool for tightening boiler valves and fixing steam pipes.
item.shortDescription: Standard heavy wrench for pipe repairs

metadata.properties: Standard issue tool for mechanical repairs. Reliable but not exceptional.

item.name: Thick Wool Scarf
item.description: A coarse, heavily worn wool scarf that Koji wraps around his neck to block the draft from the boiler room vents.
item.shortDescription: Worn wool scarf for cold protection

metadata.properties: Provides minor warmth against the cold platform drafts.

personality.type: Grumpy, Enneagram Type 6, Lawful-Social; Koji is pragmatic and risk-averse. She isn't just a grump; she is deeply concerned about the structural integrity of the platform. She trusts machines more than people because machines don't lie about their wear and tear.
personality.notes: She often mutters to the pipes as if they are stubborn children. Her ears are large and twitch at the sound of steam.
personality.aiNotes: Will complain about the cold. Will fix minor mechanical issues if asked. Will hide in the boiler room if it gets too windy.
goals: Fix the leaky steam valve in the shelter.
Earn enough paws to buy a heated coat.
Stop travelers from kicking the pipes.
Find a shiny new wrench that doesn't rust.

importantMemories: The heater in the shelter is acting up again. I tightened the valve, but the cold is getting into the pipes. I need more coal.
Rena yelled at me for dropping a wrench. She’s annoying, but she’s right. I should have used the magnetic tray this time.
A traveler asked for directions to the riverbank. I pointed him north. He looked lost. I hope he finds it before the snow gets worse.
