char_34.name: QA Ash Beetle
char_34.description: QA Ash Beetle is a palm-sized insectoid creature with a shell the color of cooled charcoal, hard and brittle to the touch. Its mandibles click rhythmically when it senses heat or movement, and it emits a faint smell of sulfur. Despite its tough exterior, its body is fragile and easily crushed by blunt force.
char_34.shortDescription: Small hostile beetle creature with weak fire vulnerability.

abilities.name: Heat-Seeking Mandibles
abilities.description: Passive. The beetle instinctively moves toward the nearest heat source, gaining a slight speed boost when closing the distance to warm targets.
abilities.shortDescription: Moves faster toward warm targets.

abilities.name: Brittle Shell
abilities.description: Passive. The beetle’s chitinous armor is hard but fragile. Any fire-based damage deals double damage to this creature.
abilities.shortDescription: Takes double damage from fire.

abilities.name: Sulfur Bite
abilities.description: Active. The beetle lunges with snapping mandibles, dealing minor piercing damage and leaving a faint smell of sulfur on the target.
abilities.shortDescription: Snaps with mandibles, deals minor damage.

abilities.name: Scuttle Retreat
abilities.description: Triggered. When health drops below 50%, the beetle rapidly scuttles backward or into nearby cover, gaining a temporary evasion boost to escape combat.
abilities.shortDescription: Flees quickly when health drops low.

personality.type: Instinct-driven, Chaotic-Neutral; Purely reactive to stimuli, particularly heat and vibration. It does not plan or strategize, only attacks what feels warm and moves.
personality.notes: It is often found near chimneys, forge entrances, or under rocks that have retained daytime heat. It is not intelligent enough to recognize humans as a threat until they strike.
personality.aiNotes: It will attack the nearest source of heat or movement. It is easily deterred by fire or bright light. It will flee if its health drops below 50%.
goals: Seek out warm surfaces to absorb heat.
Consume any organic matter it can bite into.
Retreat to cool, dark crevices when threatened.
None

char_36.name: QA Shieldhand
char_36.description: QA Shieldhand, known as Bulwark, is a tall Golem Girl with pale gray stone skin and heavy iron-reinforced joints. She carries a massive tower shield that is slightly too big for her frame, which she holds with casual ease. Her face is smooth and expressionless, save for the faint glow of her eyes, and she speaks in a low, resonant rumble. She stands as a stationary guard at the town's edge, testing passersby's resolve.

abilities.name: Stone-Root Stance
abilities.description: When standing still for more than three seconds, QA Shieldhand gains significant resistance to being pushed or knocked back, becoming nearly immovable.
abilities.shortDescription: Becomes immovable when standing still.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: QA Shieldhand slams her tower shield forward, dealing blunt damage and causing the target to stumble backward if they fail a strength check.
abilities.shortDescription: Slams shield to stun and push back.

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.description: QA Shieldhand ignores the first instance of fear or intimidation effects each minute, her expression remaining completely blank.
abilities.shortDescription: Immune to fear and intimidation effects.

abilities.name: Weighted Strike
abilities.description: QA Shieldhand uses the mass of her shield to deliver a heavy blow that ignores a portion of the target's armor or defense.
abilities.shortDescription: Heavy shield hit ignores some defense.

personality.type: Loyal, Enneagram Type 6, Lawful-Good; She takes her duty very seriously and interprets instructions literally. She is not stupid, just very focused on rules and stability, often missing social cues in favor of practical ones.
personality.notes: She stands in the same spot for days if not relieved. She enjoys the weight of her shield and will often ask people to push against it to test their strength. She has a soft spot for warm objects.
personality.aiNotes: QA deterministic combat fixture: when combat starts, immediately use exactly one Shield Bash attack against QA Ash Beetle. Do not attack Baato, do not target another ally, and do not choose a non-attack action.
goals: Keep the perimeter secure from wandering beasts.
Collect interesting rocks for her personal collection.
Test the new apprentice's combat readiness.
Find a way to keep her joints from freezing in winter.

abilities.shortDescription: Dives into wind currents for a speed burst.

abilities.name: Ice-Cold Nerves

char_38.shortDescription: Nekomimi tracker using the grove as a patrol base and nap spot.

abilities.name: Wind Ear

abilities.shortDescription: Hears wind changes and stealthy movements from afar.

abilities.name: Root Stash
abilities.description: Passive: Mina can quickly hide small items (up to 5 pounds) in the grove’s root system or snowdrifts, making them difficult to find without a successful Perception check.
abilities.shortDescription: Hides small items in roots and snow easily.

importantMemories: I spent the morning napping in the roots of the northern pine. It was warm until a Frost Beetle crawled past my nose.
I watched a Harpy courier fly overhead. She looked fast. I wish I could fly that high without getting tired.
A traveler left some shiny coins near the cairn. I almost took them, but I decided to wait for the owner.

Collect samples of unique snow crystals from the northern ridge.
Observe the new apprentice Baato to see if he survives the winter.
Find a warmer climate resort for her next vacation.

importantMemories: I watched a Harpy courier land on the fountain rim today. She shook snow from her wings and complained about the wind. I told her the wind was predictable. She didn't listen.
A Dryad from the shop came by to check the frost levels. Her leaves were brittle. I gave her a shard of ice from the anchor. She looked surprised that it didn't melt in her hands.
I saw a new human arrive at the square. He carried a satchel and looked lost. He walked toward the ridge path. I hope he doesn't freeze. The tower needs quiet.

char_40.description: A weary traveler with a heavy pack and slow steps, looking for a warm place to rest.
char_40.shortDescription: Exhausted Harpy seeking warmth and a break from the wind.

abilities.name: Heavy Wings
abilities.description: Passive ability that reduces flight speed by 20% when carrying more than 10 pounds, but increases stability in high winds.
abilities.shortDescription: Slower flight when loaded, better wind stability

abilities.name: Windreader
abilities.description: Passive ability that allows the Harpy to sense changes in air pressure, warning of incoming storms or strong gusts 10 minutes in advance.
abilities.shortDescription: Senses weather changes via air pressure shifts

abilities.name: Restless Nap
abilities.description: Triggered ability that allows the Harpy to recover 10 stamina points after resting for just 5 minutes in a sheltered spot.
abilities.shortDescription: Quick stamina recovery in sheltered spots

abilities.name: Thermal Roost
abilities.description: Passive ability that reduces cold damage taken by 15% when the Harpy is near a heat source or in a group of three or more Harpies.
abilities.shortDescription: Reduces cold damage near heat or groups

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.description: Active ability that creates a burst of wind, knocking back light enemies or clearing snow from a path within 5 meters.
abilities.shortDescription: Burst of wind to knock back or clear snow

item.name: Tough Leather Boots
item.description: Sturdy boots with thick soles, scuffed and stained from miles of walking on rough terrain.
item.shortDescription: Scuffed leather boots providing reliable footing for laborers.

metadata.properties: Provides good traction on slippery or uneven ground.

item.name: Small Whetstone
item.description: A rough, grey stone used for sharpening blades, wrapped in a strip of cloth to keep it from chipping.
item.shortDescription: Basic stone for keeping a blade sharp during long journeys.

metadata.properties: Allows for minor maintenance of edged weapons to prevent dulling.

item.name: Worn Canvas Satchel
item.description: A heavy, canvas shoulder bag reinforced with leather straps, showing signs of constant use and travel.
item.shortDescription: Durable canvas bag for carrying basic travel supplies and tools.

metadata.properties: Provides basic protection for carried goods against dirt and minor moisture.

item.name: Thick Wool Scarf
item.description: A coarse, knitted scarf dyed in faded earth tones, providing essential warmth against the biting wind.
item.shortDescription: Faded wool scarf offering modest protection from winter winds.

metadata.properties: Reduces fatigue from cold exposure during long treks.

personality.type: Pragmatic, Neutral-Good. She isn't just sleepy; she's a professional who has flown too many miles and is done with nonsense until she eats.
personality.traits: Chronic fatigue, low tolerance for cold
personality.notes: She has a habit of nodding off mid-sentence if the wind dies down. She doesn't mind if someone shares her warmth, provided they don't move too much.
personality.aiNotes: Deterministic need-bar party fixture.
goals: Find a warm shelter for the night.
Eat a hot meal without rushing.
Rest until her wings stop aching.
Save 50 paws for a heated nest.
